explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/920: f_k(n) is the maximum chromatic number of a K_k-free graph on n vertices. Is f_k(n) ≫ n^{1-1/(k-1)}/(log n)^{c_k} for k ≥ 4 and some c_k > 0? The page says it is solved positively via Mattheus–Verstraete (k = 4) and Bradač (k ≥ 5). f is a supremum over graphs on Fin n, and ≫ unfolds to g = O(f). The statement asserts the positive answer. Faithful.
